All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
@NativeType("struct spng_bkgd") public class spng_bkgd extends Struct<spng_bkgd> implements NativeResource
struct spng_bkgd {
    uint16_t gray;
    uint16_t red;
    uint16_t green;
    uint16_t blue;
    uint16_t plte_index;
}
